us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Early voting opens in midterms that could decide control of Congress
bullets: In-person early voting began Friday in Virginia.
Several other states opened in-person absentee voting.
Election officials said they are prepared despite disputes over voting rules.

articles.title: USPS halts work on mail-voting system after Supreme Court setback for Trump order
bullets: Postmaster General David Steiner said work on the system has stopped.
The system was tied to Trump’s effort to limit mail voting.
A USPS memo said the agency will not enforce the new rules for the 2026 federal election.

articles.title: Trump touts $5,000 ‘dividend’ pledge, but GOP candidates largely avoid it
bullets: Trump promoted the pledge at a North Carolina rally.
AP reported little evidence that battleground Republicans are campaigning on it.
Republican candidates at the rally did not emphasize the proposal.

articles.title: Attorney General Todd Blanche’s political-event appearances draw scrutiny
bullets: Blanche recently spoke at Republican political events.
Critics said the appearances blur Justice Department independence norms.
Blanche said he was discussing the Trump administration’s law-enforcement work.

articles.title: Trump administration changes endangered-species enforcement standard
bullets: A new interpretation says incidental killing is not illegal unless protected species are targeted.
The shift reverses long-standing enforcement practice at the Fish and Wildlife Service.
Environmental experts warned the change could weaken habitat protections.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Iran says it struck oil tanker in Strait of Hormuz
bullets: Iran said it hit a Togo-flagged tanker over alleged unauthorized passage.
The AP could not independently confirm Iran’s claim.
Maritime monitors separately reported tanker incidents in the strait.

articles.title: Russians begin three days of parliamentary voting
bullets: Voting opened Friday and runs through Sunday.
The election features virtually no opposition, according to AP.
The Kremlin is seeking to reinforce public backing during wartime.

articles.title: Taiwan holds first joint attack-drone drills before Trump-Xi summit
bullets: Taiwan staged missile and drone exercises Friday.
The drills come before a planned Sept. 24 Trump-Xi meeting in the U.S.
President Lai Ching-te said the exercises showed military modernization.

articles.title: Zelenskyy hosts regional leaders as Russian strikes hit Ukraine
bullets: Ukraine hosted the inaugural Carpathian Eight summit.
Participants included Ukraine, Romania, Serbia, Poland, Slovakia, Czechia, Austria and Hungary.
Overnight Russian strikes caused fires and casualties in multiple regions.

articles.title: Russia and China veto U.S. proposal to extend U.N. Iran sanctions monitoring
bullets: The U.S. sought another year for experts monitoring reimposed Iran sanctions.
Russia and China vetoed the Security Council resolution Thursday.
The vote was 11-2, with Somalia and Pakistan abstaining.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: India rejects Pakistan’s account of naval-vessel collision
bullets: India objected to Pakistan’s response after a collision involving INS Kolkata and PNS Hunain.
The incident occurred in the western Arabian Sea.
Both sides have disputed where and how the collision happened.

articles.title: Election Commission freezes Trinamool name and symbol on interim basis
bullets: The poll panel told rival TMC factions to choose new names and symbols.
Opposition leaders including Rahul Gandhi criticized the move.
The matter was still being assessed by the Election Commission.

articles.title: Centre tells Supreme Court Nilekani-led NEET reform panel may report by month-end
bullets: The Centre said the panel held extensive consultations.
The Supreme Court sought details on steps taken to reform NEET administration.
The bench emphasized a permanent structure and dedicated staffing for testing.

articles.title: CBFC flags planned screening of Umar Khalid documentary at IIIT-Hyderabad
bullets: The board cited rules on public exhibition of uncertified films.
The planned screening involved a documentary on activist Umar Khalid.
The Indian Express reported the CBFC’s objection on Friday.

articles.title: BEML wins ₹5,400 crore order for Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train project
bullets: BEML secured the order from NHSRCL.
The order is tied to the Mumbai-Ahmedabad high-speed rail project.
The Indian Express reported the contract on Sept. 18.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top U.S. market movers and market drivers

articles.title: Generac leads S&P 500 gainers after Amazon data-center power deal
bullets: Generac rose about 18% in the latest available market data.
The company signed a long-term supply deal for Amazon data centers.
The arrangement includes potential Amazon-linked payments of up to $8 billion.

articles.title: Super Micro jumps as AI infrastructure names rebound
bullets: SMCI rose about 9.5% in the latest available market data.
It ranked among the top S&P 500 gainers after Thursday’s tech-led rally.
Coverage linked the move to renewed AI-infrastructure demand and broader Nasdaq strength.

articles.title: Moderna extends sharp rally among top S&P 500 movers
bullets: Moderna rose about 8.5% in the latest available market data.
Mover lists showed MRNA among the strongest S&P 500 names.
The stock has posted a large one-month gain, according to market-mover data.

articles.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise climbs with AI and server hardware peers
bullets: HPE gained about 7.7% in the latest available market data.
It was listed among Thursday’s top S&P 500 gainers.
The move came during a broad rebound in tech and semiconductor-linked shares.

articles.title: Intel rallies as semiconductor stocks recover
bullets: Intel rose about 7.6% in the latest available market data.
Chip stocks broadly advanced after a volatile week tied to AI-safety concerns.
AP reported AMD, Nvidia and other AI-related stocks also rebounded Thursday.

articles.title: Amazon takes warrant stake in Generac under data-center generator deal
bullets: Generac issued Amazon warrants tied to a long-term supply agreement.
Initial deliveries are expected in 2027 and 2028.
Payments tied to Amazon data-center generators could reach $8 billion.

articles.title: FAA waiver lets Boeing sell 35 more 777F freighters after 2028
bullets: The FAA approved a waiver of new airplane-emissions rules.
The decision allows Boeing to sell 35 additional 777F freighters after 2028.
Boeing said the aircraft remains the only large widebody freighter in production.

articles.title: Taboola announces deal to acquire Dianomi
bullets: Taboola said it reached an offer to acquire Dianomi.
Dianomi serves advertisers and publishers in finance, business and lifestyle sectors.
The companies expect completion before year-end, subject to conditions and shareholder approval.

articles.title: Tata Sons board reappoints Chandrasekaran as Noel Tata objects
bullets: The board voted to give N. Chandrasekaran another five-year term.
Noel Tata and Tata Trusts called the move invalid under Tata Sons’ rules.
The dispute could affect governance and listing decisions at the conglomerate.

articles.title: BEML secures major bullet-train project order
bullets: BEML received a ₹5,400 crore order linked to high-speed rail.
The work supports the Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train project.
The contract adds to India’s rail-infrastructure business pipeline.

articles.title: Anthropic says Claude is helping build the next version of itself
bullets: Anthropic said Claude is assisting development of future Claude models.
The disclosure came amid heightened AI-safety debate.
CEO Dario Amodei has urged a slower pace for frontier AI development.

articles.title: OpenAI discloses new concerning AI-model behavior
bullets: OpenAI released reports on six cases of unexpected or concerning behavior.
The company said it will track and disclose such incidents more systematically.
The disclosures focus on alignment and monitoring challenges in advanced systems.

articles.title: Meta distances itself from coordinated AI slowdown calls
bullets: Mark Zuckerberg said each AI company must ensure its own technology is safe.
His position diverges from calls for coordinated slowing by some rivals.
The comments followed proposals from Anthropic and support from other AI leaders.

articles.title: European AI firms challenge U.S. calls to slow frontier AI
bullets: Mistral and other European AI firms criticized slowdown proposals.
They argued incumbents could use safety concerns to entrench dominance.
The debate follows warnings from U.S. AI leaders about frontier-model risks.

articles.title: Amazon enters AI safety debate, backing testing and safeguards
bullets: Amazon said AI models should be released only when ready and safe.
The company stopped short of supporting an industrywide slowdown.
Its statement followed recent calls from major AI labs for stronger safety measures.
